newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Volcano alert is declared in western Nicaragua.
newsitem.headline: Volcano alert is declared in western Nicaragua.

text.p: Nicaraguan authorities declared a state of alert in the western city of Chinandega late on Tuesday as the nearby San Cristobal volcano entered an eruption phase.
Radio Nicaragua broadcast the alert after San Cristobal, around 94 miles (150 km) southwest of Managua, registered approximately 600 seismic shudders in 24 hours.
National vulcanologists inspecting San Cristobal, which borders Honduras and last erupted in 1981, advised the Chinandega emergency committee of the danger, and local authorities put out the alert.

"(San Cristobal) has entered into an eruption phase. To date, it has only thrown up ash and gases, but we are watching out, because it is a very dangerous volcano," Fabio Segura, director of seismology at the Nicaraguan Territorial Studies Institute, told Reuters.
